data.body: **[P1] Do not count child payload-load failures as business failures.** Passing the offloader into child contexts means `child.get()` can now throw `PayloadOffloadException` while loading a replayed successful result. `onItemComplete` catches every throwable and increments `failedCount`, while map/parallel result assembly likewise converts it into a failed item. A transient storage outage can therefore be durably checkpointed as a workflow failure or trigger early completion. Rethrow payload-offload failures from these catch sites so normal invocation classification handles them, with map and parallel replay tests.
